owners.label: True Names Invoked
owners.description:
Casting Intro Skill - Solsworn Etymology grants Convergent for 20s.


Convergent

The next time Sigrika obtains a Rune, she additionally obtains a Rune of the same type and removes Convergent.
When Sigrika holds Divergent and Convergent at the same time, Convergent takes priority.
When Sigrika holds 100 points of Full Stop, Convergent doesn't take effect.

owners.label: True Names Aligned
owners.description:
When any nearby Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Sigrika gains a stack of Blessing of Runes, up to 6 stacks. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once.
This effect resets upon a lineup change.


Blessing of Runes

Each stack of Blessing of Runes grants the active Resonator in the team 3% Aero DMG Bonus and 3% Echo Skill DMG Bonus.
When Blessing of Runes reaches 6 stacks, Sigrika additionally gains 30% Aero DMG Bonus and Echo Skill DMG Bonus.


For every 1% of Sigrika's Energy Regen over 125%, Sigrika gains 2% Echo Skill DMG Bonus for up to 50%.

owners.label: In This Very Moment
owners.description:
Attack the target, deal Aero DMG equal to 795% of Sigrika's ATK. Gain 2 stacks of Encapsulated for 30s.


Encapsulated

When any nearby Resonators in the team cast Echo Skills, Stagnate the target and consume 1 stacks of Encapsulated. Encapsulated stacks up to 2 times.
All stacks of Encapsulated are removed when Sigrika is removed from the lineup.

owners.label: The Gleam Meant for Radiance
owners.description:
The DMG Multipliers of Basic Attack - Elucidated, Dodge Counter - Decipher, Resonance Skill - BIG BOOMY BOOM!, and Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid are increased by 70%.
Sigrika becomes immune to interruptions while casting Basic Attack - Elucidated, Resonance Skill - BIG BOOMY BOOM!, and Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid.
Encapsulated now stacks up to 3 times. After casting Outro Skill In This Very Moment, Sigrika obtains 1 additional stacks.

owners.label: The Bitterness Steeped in Hope
owners.description:
The DMG Multiplier of Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name is increased by 120%.
When not in combat for over 4s, Sigrika gains Divergent. This effect is active for up to 1 time every 4s.

owners.label: I Flee, Yet I Seek
owners.description:
Innate Gift? now stacks up to 4 times and is no longer removed after Sigrika casts Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name or is switched off the field.
When not in combat, all Innate Gift? stacks are removed every 30s.

owners.label: I Lose, Yet I Gain
owners.description: When a Resonator in the team casts Echo Skill, all Resonators in the team gain an 20% ATK increase for 20s.

owners.label: Until Submerged by the Dark
owners.description: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Where Trust Leads Me! is increased by 30%.

owners.label: True Names Resurfaced, Rising in Light
owners.description:
Targets take 30% more DMG from Sigrika.
Innate Gift? gains following effects:
- Each stack additionally grants Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, Runic Soliskin, and Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name 15% DMG Amplification, up to 60%.
- Each stack causes Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, Runic Soliskin, and Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name to ignore 7.5% of the target's DEF when dealing damage, up to 30%.

owners.label: Soliskin Vitality
owners.description: Sigrika consumes Soliskin Vitality to amplify Runic skills' damage dealt.
